items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And you used to like Pierron's band? [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, he had a fine band.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's where I started. In 10. That was in a book or you were just heard? Well, it was a piano copy. I think I bought it by Willow in the 90s. Willow on Knausley. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I heard that. Yes, years ago. I never forget that song. I think about it, you know. Just like that. stuff one of those clubs, I just remember the name of it. Yeah, he had a band running then. The Elkish. Tuxley Elkish.
And you used to like Pierron's band?
Yeah, he had a fine band.
